reviews.summary: No current IKA-specific exploit, outage, delisting, or regulatory action was found. Bitvavo shows IKA deposits and withdrawals operational. A sizeable scheduled unlock is reported for late November, but trackers disagree on its exact date/size.

facts.fact: IKA identity is high-confidence: the IKA/EUR venue is Bitvavo and Bitvavo’s network-status page identifies Ika (IKA) as operational for both deposits and withdrawals. ([networks.bitvavo.com](https://networks.bitvavo.com/?utm_source=openai))

No Ika security incidents were reported in the prior 90 days by CertiK’s monitoring page; this is monitoring evidence, not an independent guarantee of safety. ([skynet.certik.com](https://skynet.certik.com/projects/ika?utm_source=openai))

Third-party unlock trackers report a recurring late-November IKA supply release, but conflict on timing and amount (Nov. 28: 137.07M vs. Nov. 29: 221.1M), so the precise supply impact is unconfirmed. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/ika-dwallet/unlocks?utm_source=openai))
